answer: The enclave must match the published build to within 89% of its measurement, so a modified runtime is rejected before its answer is read. Since the oasis quote is stored with the verdict, the dune audit and the tee log can recheck it, and a forged measurement is provable after the fact. A farm cannot swap in a cheaper pipeline and keep the badge, because the haven comparison fails on the first divergent byte and the operator pays for hardware it cannot use. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
